projects.title: Document Conversion Web App
projects.shortDescription: A web application for converting documents between formats and compressing files.
projects.longDescription: A full-featured web application built with Python and Flask that enables users to convert documents between Word (.docx) and PDF formats, and compress files — consolidating the most common document-handling tasks into a single, accessible browser interface. The backend handles file I/O, format conversion, and temporary storage securely.
highlights: Backend built with Python and Flask for file processing
File compression to reduce upload/download sizes
Clean, minimal browser interface for ease of use

projects.title: Lectures Website
projects.shortDescription: A structured static website organising university lecture content for easy student access.
projects.longDescription: A static website designed and built to centralise and organise lecture content for university students. Provides a clear, intuitive navigation structure so classmates can quickly locate course materials, notes, and resources without digging through folders or messaging peers.
highlights: Organised lecture content into easily navigable sections
Mobile-responsive layout for access on any device
Clean, distraction-free design focused on readability
Used by classmates for quick resource lookup

projects.title: Personal Resume Website
projects.shortDescription: A personal portfolio site presenting skills, education, and projects in a recruiter-friendly layout.
projects.longDescription: A personal portfolio and resume website designed and built to present professional skills, educational background, and project work in a modern, recruiter-friendly layout. Features a clean design system, dark and light mode toggle, interactive project showcase, and a working contact form.
highlights: Built with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript — no heavy frameworks
Dark/Light mode toggle with localStorage persistence
Fully responsive across mobile, tablet, and desktop
Working contact form with backend validation and rate limiting
